analyst.summary: Jai Balaji has done real work paying down debt over the past several years, but its underlying steel and ferro-alloys business has weakened sharply and recently -- operating margins have collapsed from 18% to just 5% and quarterly profit has fallen by more than half in the most recent comparison. Combined with a notable 31% pledge of promoter shares, this points to genuine near-term stress in the core business rather than a temporary blip, even though the balance sheet itself is in much better shape than it used to be.
